subject: What's new in GiesChat: drafts now keep up with your changes
preheader: Your TAs' drafts now keep up with your changes, and agents can read your course website.
headline: Drafts now keep up with your changes

intro.faculty: Here is what changed in GiesChat this month and what it means for the agents you run for your classes.
intro.all: Here is what changed in GiesChat this month. Items marked Faculty are for people who build agents for their classes.

clip.alt: Before and after: a TA's draft used to fall behind silently; now they see a notice, open Update my draft, choose where you both edited, and the draft is current again.
clip.caption: Before: when you changed an agent, a TA's draft fell behind without anyone knowing. After: they see it on their draft and update in one click.

changes.title: How it works for your TAs
changes.body: If you change an agent while a TA is working on a draft, they get a note and can bring their draft up to date in one step. Where you both edited the same thing, they see both versions and choose.

changes.title: Agents can learn from your course website
changes.body: In the agent builder, paste a course or department web address under Websites. GiesChat reads up to 50 pages from that site, saves a clean copy for your agent, and checks it again every night, so answers keep up when your site changes.

changes.title: Pictures of tables and charts now count
changes.body: Add a photo or screenshot of a table or chart to an agent and GiesChat reads the numbers into text, so students can ask about them.

changes.title: The class dashboard is now the Agent dashboard
changes.body: Same place, new name. People you invite as collaborators or co-admins now get access to it automatically, so you no longer need to request it for them.

changes.title: Newer models
changes.body: Chat now runs on GPT-6 Luna. Class agents can also use GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Sonnet, Opus and Haiku 5.5.
